# spacelift_stack (List Resource)

Lists every stack in the account.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_child_spaces` (Boolean) With `space_id`, also list stacks in its child spaces, at any depth.
- `labels` (List of String) Only list stacks that have all of these labels.
- `name` (String) Only list stacks whose name matches this pattern. `*` matches any characters, and case is ignored.
- `space_id` (String) Only list stacks in this space.
